reason: A DSH interface enhancement that adds an animated pixel-whale desktop pet, reacts to token usage and conversation state, and displays configurable celebratory visual effects.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 界面添加常驻右下角的像素鲸鱼桌宠，并根据对话状态和 token 用量展示动画、称号及庆祝特效。
summaries.en: Adds a persistent pixel-whale desktop pet to the DSH interface with animations, randomized titles, and celebratory effects driven by conversation state and token usage.

capabilities: injects an animated pixel-whale overlay into the DSH interface
reads agent status to detect conversation completion
reads LLM stream usage to detect token growth
displays randomized labels and visual effects
